svg.title: Flatten each patch and project it into one vector
svg.desc: The same 4×4 image is split into 2×2 patches A,B,C,D. Flattening A’s four red pixels in row-major pixel order and RGB order creates x_A[12], four groups of [1,0,0]. Shared W_patch[4×12] produces A=[1,0,0,1/3], B=[0,1,0,1/3], C=[0,0,1,1/3], D=[1,1,1,1]. Each channel-mean row of W uses 1/4 at that channel’s four positions; the final row uses 1/12 everywhere.

g.text: One vector shown as four groups
Within each pixel: R → G → B
B. Project every patch with W
Shared: the same W for A, B, C and D
Learned W is a general projection
